description:
Recognize and analyze particles in an electron microscope image.

        Use this tool for:
            - particle detection in electron microscopy (EM) images.
            - Extracting particle boundaries and computing geometric descriptors.
            - Converting pixel-based measurements into physical dimensions using scale bar information.
            - Filtering and flagging invalid, edge-touching, or occluded particles.
            - Producing summary statistics (size distribution, aspect ratio, circularity, etc.).
            - Exporting structured measurement results for further quantitative analysis.
            - Generating concise, human-readable summaries for downstream LLM reasoning.
        Args:
            img_path (Path): The path of the electron microscope image to analyze.
                Supported formats: Common image formats (jpg, png, tif, etc.)

        Returns:
            Dict[str, Any]: Structured result object with the following fields:
                - status (Literal["success","error"]):
                    Execution status; "success" means the analysis completed, "error" means a failure occurred.
                - file_name (str):
                    The input image file name.
                - scale (Dict):
                    Scale bar and unit conversion info.
                    - nm_per_pixel (Optional[float]): Nanometers per pixel (nm/px); None if unavailable.
                    - scalebar_value_nm (Optional[float]): Physical length of the scale bar (nm).
                    - scalebar_width_px (Optional[float]): Pixel width corresponding to the scale bar.
                - counts (Dict):
                    Particle counts.
                    - total (int): Total detected particles.
                    - valid (int): Valid particles (excluding edge and invalid).
                    - edge (int): Edge-touching particles (is_edge == True).
                    - invalid (int): Invalid particles (is_invalid == True).
                    - occluded (int): Particles occluded by overlays or the scale bar.
                - stats (Dict):
                    Descriptive statistics computed on available, non-empty values.
                    - area_nm2 (Dict): mean, p50, std, min, max for particle area (nm²).
                    - diameter_nm (Dict): mean, p50, std, min, max for equivalent circle diameter (nm).
                    - aspect_ratio (Dict): mean, p50, std, min, max for major/minor axis ratio.
                    - circularity (Dict): mean, p50, std, min, max for circularity (4π·area / perimeter²).
                - particles_sample (List[Dict]):
                    Compact sample of particles (limited count; polygons not included), each with:
                    - id (int): Sample index.
                    - centroid_px (List[float, float]): Centroid in pixels [x, y].
                    - diameter_nm (Optional[float]): Equivalent circle diameter (nm); None if no scale.
                    - area_nm2 (Optional[float]): Area (nm²); None if no scale.
                    - circularity (Optional[float]): Circularity metric.
                    - aspect_ratio (Optional[float]): Major/minor axis ratio.
                    - flags (Dict): Flags for quality control (edge/invalid/occluded).
                - artifacts_csv_path (Path): Path to the CSV file.
                - overlay_image_path (Optional[Path]): Path to the overlay image with detected particles drawn.  
                - raw (Dict):
                    Raw result summary.
                    - data_count (int): Number of raw items in "data".
                    - scalebar_present (bool): Whether usable scale bar info is present.
                - llm_text (str):
                    Human-readable summary for LLMs, covering counts, key stats, and scale info.
name: get_electron_microscope_recognize
